messages:
aj: quick heads-up — opened PR 4821 to tweak the KV eviction heuristic in runtime. small change but touches cache keys and a logging path that reads from KMS. need runtime + infra + security eyes before i schedule a canary. cc @lee @taylor @mya
lee: thanks — can you summarise the behavior change in 1–2 lines? curious about if this will increase cache misses for short-lived sessions
aj: sure — change makes eviction prefer entries with stale-ttl < 30s over large-prefix entries. goal is to free space faster for short requests. rough numbers: +3% miss rate on microbench, -18% tail latency for small seq workloads.
taylor: pinging infra — do we need config changes on the autoscaler or node flags for the rollout? also any change in memory churn?
aj: no node flags. memory churn up ~4% in peak mem during bench but within headroom. autoscaler unaffected per my tests. attaching bench run: https://git.internal/r/4821
mya: security question — you mentioned KMS read on a logging path. does this add any new principal with access? who holds audit logs?
aj: no new principals. we're reusing existing metrics-service key. logs go to the same bucket/audit pipeline. i added an ACL check in the PR:```diff
- log_decrypt(key)
+ log_decrypt_if_allowed(key, principal=metrics-service)
```
sam: happy to own the canary if runtime and sec are 👍 — what's the target canary window?
aj: thanks — planning 4h canary on staging then 2h on prod-perf ring. canary command: `./deploy --canary pr-4821 --window 4h`
lee: code LGTM from runtime pov except add a comment around the ttl threshold. can you add a quick unit test for the eviction comparator?
aj: on it, will add test and update PR by EOD.
mya: i looked at keys/audit — fine from sec side as long as logs stay encrypted and ACLs unchanged. small nits in the PR comments. i'll mark as +sec after you address them.
ci-bot: CI passed: all checks green (build, unit, lint). https://ci.internal/builds/4821/status
taylor: infra eyes — memory delta acceptable. could you include the bench output in the PR description so we have it for post-mortem if canary spikes?
aj: added bench artifacts and a short summary to PR description. scheduling canary after tests & nits fixed. thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: i'll start the staging canary once aj updates tests. ping me when ready.
aj: updated tests + comment + addressed sec nits. ready for staging canary.
lee: approving from runtime after test added.
mya: approving from sec.
taylor: infra ack. merge at will after 10:30am PT merge window if no regressions.
